# You Built It {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

From a chat box to a working assistant

## The Toolkit You Now Have {auto-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- **A good prompt (RICE)** — delegate like you brief a TA
- **Claude Cowork** — an assistant working on your real files
- **Skills / Schedule / Scripts** — recurring work, done for you
- **NotebookLM** — grounded summaries and decks from your sources
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
None of it is magic — it's all the office getting smarter about **what to re-send.**
:::
